title: feat(units): show a quantity with its unit label (#35490)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg8ZBQe4UHadd2fGHGeWRW9V)_

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbdHk3orAeensH6EzS

Fixes #35490
Fixes #37471

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added

## What

A quantity (`unitConfig` on a `number` field) now renders with its unit on every display face: the grid cell, the form (read-only and edited), and the detail row (DetailSection, the quick-look panel, RelatedList). A unit-code `text` field (`unitMode: 'code'`) shows its unit's name (Open item 8 (A)).

- **Choosing a unit (Open item 8, ruled A: 「有下拉」, #37471).** In a form, a unit code field is a searchable picker (`UnitCodeField`), never a typed box. That covers a `text` field declaring `unitMode: 'code'` and the `unitField` a `record` quantity on the same form points at; the form stamps that pointer (`withUnitCodePointer`) and hands the field its record. The picker lists the record's organization's non-retired `sys_unit` rows, then every standard code, each by its translated name (spec fallback) and limited to the declared `unitDimension`. It stores the code. Read-only, the field shows the unit's name, not the bare code.
- **Authorable key (`Metadata-protocol: added`).** `unitConfig` is now declared on `@object-ui/types`' `FormField` / `FormFieldSchema`, by reference to the spec's `FieldSchema.unitConfig`, beside `currencyConfig`, so `objectui validate` accepts it on a hand-authored form field. `@object-ui/types` ships `minor` (the `scale` / `currencyConfig` precedent). The tolerant face now checks the key's value against `UnitConfigSchema` where it passed as an unknown key before.

- **Which unit.** Fixed mode uses `unitConfig.unit`. Record mode reads the row's `unitField`. Grid, ListView and RelatedList add the unit column and `organization_id` to their `$select` when the unit column is not shown.
- **Name.** An org unit (`sys_unit`, U3) shows its `label`. A standard code shows the platform's name for it in the reader's locale (L2, 2A): the spec English base `STANDARD_UNIT_NAMES`, and each platform bundle serves `messages.standardUnit<CODE>`. The UI reads `app.messages.standardUnit<CODE>` and falls back to the English base.
- **Decimals.** These come from the unit row (org unit `decimal_places`, or the `sys_standard_unit_setting` row for a standard code, OI10 (A)). The row is the one whose `organization_id` matches the record's organization (note 7180167601). L4 holds: the display width is `min(unit places, field scale)`.
- **Rounding (OI6, ruled A).** The display rounds half away from zero (Intl `halfExpand`) at a fixed width. The stored value, footer totals (summed exact, then formatted), exports, the API and MCP stay exact. No marker is shown.
- **Bare code.** A retired ("deleted") org unit, an unknown code, or a reader who may not read `sys_unit` (an external member, comment 7030066814) gets the bare code, never an error.

The rows are read once per data-source adapter for the session (the `homeAmountPreview` precedent). Each table is read on its own, so a refusal of one leaves the other usable.

## Server-side home of the names (measured)

The platform-objects translation bundles, flat `messages` map, with single-segment keys `standardUnit<CODE>`. The keys are not dotted `units.standard.<CODE>` because `FileI18nAdapter.resolveKey` splits on `.` and walks the parts as nesting (the plugin-audit precedent). The console's served document lays bundles under `app`, so the UI key is `app.messages.standardUnit<CODE>`. English is copied from the spec base, never re-typed. Ten locales are translated, and a pin test holds every locale to exactly the 41 codes.

## Acceptance notes

- **platform-catalog row:** deferred to #37431 (`skills/**` fence).
- **Standalone `ObjectGrid` with no `SchemaRendererContext`:** there is no data source, so no unit rows are read. Codes show bare at the field's own width. This known limit is pinned in `gridQuantityUnit-35490.test.tsx`.
- **English names are singular,** e.g. `1,235 kilogram`.
- **The catalog is cached per adapter for the session.** A unit edited mid-session shows after a reload. A failed read stays unread for the session; this is deliberate, because an external member's refusal is permanent and re-reading per mount would cost a request per grid cell. Follow-ups N4/N5 are on #37472.
- **Grid and detail cells of a pointed unit field** show the stored code. The pointer is stamped on the form face, where the quantity and its unit field sit together.
- **Known overlap with #37436 (#36806).** Both PRs edit the `const extraFields = [...]` line in `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridRowLoad.ts`: this PR appends `...quantityUnitFields`, and #37436 inserts `...lockOperandFields`. Whichever lands second merges main and keeps both entries.

## Verification

- Card tests: core 21, fields 26, components form, plugin-grid 2, plugin-list, plugin-detail 3. green; the fields, core, components-form and schema-catalog suites (13,000+ tests) pass on the picker head. spec `standard-units` 18/18; platform-objects translations 613/613.
- Ablations, each restored to blob == HEAD:
  - resolver → 24/52 red;
  - org-row pick → 8/48 red;
  - served-name read → 1/26 red (the zh served-name case);
  - picker's retired-unit filter → 4/56 red;
  - form pointer stamp → 1/2 red;
  - TextField's picker branch → 3/30 red.
- Typecheck: spec, platform-objects and fields are clean. `check:api-surface` was regenerated (2 added exports).
- Gates: `check-i18n-bundles`, `check-i18n-stale-fill` and `check-i18n-walk-parity` pass. `check-published-readme-exports` passes.
- `overlap-check`: clean against main, #37437, #37436 and #37427.
